search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/VPC 
| json "message","logStream","logGroup"
| parse field=message "* * * * * * * * * * * * * *" as version,accountID,interfaceID,src_ip,dest_ip,src_port,dest_port,Protocol,Packets,bytes,StartSample,EndSample,Action,status
| endsample - startsample as flow_time
| formatDate(fromSeconds(StartSample), "MM-dd-yyyy hh:mm") as StartSample
| formatDate(fromSeconds(EndSample), "MM/dd/yy HH:mm") as EndSample
| count by src_ip, startsample, endsample, flow_time
| sort by flow_time desc
//| fields -_count
